plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: Run the session (Opus 5 or Fable 5 parent) as a hook-enforced pure orchestrator: a PreToolUse hook blocks the main agent's edits and mutating Bash, implementation goes to workers pinned to Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 5 / Haiku. Under an Opus parent Fable 5 is consulted as a persistent advisor at mandatory escalation triggers; under a Fable parent the orchestrator is the top judgment tier itself.
